description: AB617 East Oakland - Ferry Routes is a dataset listed in Metropolitan Transportation Commission open data portal (data.bayareametro.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by Metropolitan Transportation Commission. Commuter ferry routes within the AB617 East Oakland emissions inventory domain. Information is from the San Francisco Bay Ferry route for Harbor Bay. Coverage: San Francisco Bay Area. The portal files it under the category Transportation. Its tags are baaqmd-opendata, baaqmd, baaqmd-ab617-eoak. The table has 24 columns. Attribution on the portal: BAAQMD. The portal shows 2023-07-31 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-bayareametro-gov-portal.
